title: ResolutionOverride
description: Contract for a correction an AI agent (or a human) supplies for a skipped/ambiguous DiscoveredFunctionality item (FR-020). An array of these is the input to the `apply-overrides` CLI command.

identityKey.description: FK to the DiscoveredFunctionality item being corrected, from the ExtractionReport.

verification.description: Populated by `apply-overrides` after it makes a real call — not supplied by the agent.

appliedAt.description: MUST only be set when verification.succeeded is true (FR-020).
